crossRefs.note: As for Ephraim, their glory will fly away like a bird. There will be no birth, no one with child, and no conception.
His roots will be dried up beneath. His branch will be cut off above.
Therefore as the tongue of fire devours the stubble, and as the dry grass sinks down in the flame, so their root shall…
They are planted scarcely. They are sown scarcely. Their stock has scarcely taken root in the ground. He merely blows…
“For, behold, the day comes, it burns as a furnace; and all the proud, and all who work wickedness, will be stubble…
‘Speak to the house of Israel, “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I will profane my sanctuary, the pride of your power…
crossRefs.keyword: the beloved fruit. Heb. the desires

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

translations.web: Ephraim is struck. Their root has dried up. They will bear no fruit. Even though they give birth, yet I will kill the beloved ones of their womb.”
translations.bsb: Ephraim is struck down; their root is withered; they cannot bear fruit. Even if they bear children, I will slay the darlings of their wombs.
translations.kjv: Ephraim is smitten, their root is dried up, they shall bear no fruit: yea, though they bring forth, yet will I slay even the beloved fruit of their womb.
translations.asv: Ephraim is smitten, their root is dried up, they shall bear no fruit: yea, though they bring forth, yet will I slay the beloved fruit of their womb.
